title: Filter
description: Bedrock's declarative predicate system, 106 tests. SC-140. NOT Molang — filters accept no expressions, only structured comparisons. Compiled at ingest into a typed predicate tree because filters run on the AI hot path.

filter.description: A bare array in the source is implicitly all_of; the IR always normalises it to an explicit group.

children.description: Evaluated in declaration order with short-circuiting. Order is normative: packs are written assuming cheap tests come first (SC-140 section 2).

test.description: One of the 106 test names, unnamespaced as Bedrock writes them. An unrecognised test is kept here and evaluates to false with one diagnostic per site (SC-140 section 2).

known.description: False when the test name is not in the recognised set. Downstream uses this rather than re-checking.

subject.description: Defaults to 'self' when the source omitted it. A subject the evaluation context does not bind yields false.

operator.description: Normalised: 'equals' becomes '==', 'not' becomes '!='. Defaults to '==' when omitted.

domain.description: Test-specific qualifier, e.g. the state name for is_block or the property name for int_property.

value.description: Compared against the test's result. Type is test-specific; the IR preserves the source type rather than coercing.
